newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila firms discard bids for 35,000 T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Manila firms discard bids for 35,000 T U.S. wheat.

text.p: Two Philippine flour mills rejected bids for 35,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat as prices submitted were high, traders said on Tuesday.
The flour mills invited tenders on Monday for 25,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat and 10,000 tonnes of western white wheat for December-January shipment.
Traders said eight companies participated in the bidding.
Last November 28, another Manila flour mill rejected bids for 24,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat also citing high prices.
